allow_instructions: Allow read-only commands that inspect files, directories, Git status, Git diffs, and project configuration.
Allow running local unit tests, integration tests, linters, formatters, type checks, and build commands.
Allow starting local development services that do not modify production or external resources.
block_instructions: Require approval before deleting files or directories.
Require approval before git push, force push, reset --hard, clean, rebase, merge, or checkout operations that may discard changes.
Require approval before applying database migrations or commands that modify or delete database data.
Require approval before Docker commands that delete containers, images, networks, or volumes.
Require approval before modifying files outside the current workspace.
Require approval before accessing production systems, cloud resources, remote databases, deployment services, or external secrets.
Require approval before installing system-wide packages or running commands with administrator privileges.
